nodes.name: Python MCP Server Endpoint Parity Proposal
nodes.summary: Proposes adding missing MCP tools to sdk/mcp/server.py: get_live_beliefs (proxies GET /memory/live_beliefs), purge_expired (proxies POST /memory/consolidate), and a fix to include Perception in the add_memory record_type enum. Addresses a runtime ValueError caused by agents calling an unregistered tool. No Rust changes required.

nodes.name: Python MCP Server Endpoint Parity Design
nodes.summary: Details the implementation of get_live_beliefs and purge_expired as Python handler functions in sdk/mcp/server.py, both proxying to the running Rust server. Includes tool registration schemas, handler code, and dispatch integration. Also corrects the add_memory record_type enum to include Perception as the 5th tier.

nodes.name: Python MCP Server Endpoint Parity Tasks
nodes.summary: Completed task checklist for the python-server-endpoint-parity change. Covers schema alignment (adding Perception, updating search_memory harness comment) and live-beliefs/purge tool implementation (schemas, handlers, dispatch bindings). All tasks marked complete.
